query:
EVALUATE
FILTER (
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS (
        'Location Details'[Country],
        'Location Details'[Geographic Region],
        TREATAS ( { 2020 }, 'Calender'[Year] ),
        "Sales", [Total Sales],
        "SalesLY", [Sales LY],
        "Profit", [Total Profit]
    ),
    NOT ISBLANK ( [Sales] ) && NOT ISBLANK ( [SalesLY] ) && [Sales] < [SalesLY]
)
ORDER BY [Sales] - [SalesLY]
